games.name: Izvēlies pareizo atbildi
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly 2 short questions ABOUT TODAY'S GOSPEL TEXT. REQUIRED: questions[{question, options (3–4), correct_answer (0-based index), explanation}] length 2. UI shows both questions stacked in one panel. NOT everyday life scenarios.

games.name: Patiess vai nepatiess
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly 2 true/false statements ABOUT TODAY'S GOSPEL. REQUIRED: questions[{question (statement), options:["Patiess","Nepatiess"], correct_answer (0 or 1), explanation}] length 2. UI: both stacked; immediate reveal after tap (green/red + explanation).

games.name: Aizpildi tukšo vietu
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: 2–3 blanks FROM TODAY'S GOSPEL wording/main idea. REQUIRED: blanks[{question (sentence with ___), answer, explanation}]. UI shows all stacked; one Check validates all — correct lock in, wrong stay editable for retry.

games.name: Sajaukti burti
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly ONE important word/name from today's Gospel. REQUIRED: scrambled, answer, explanation (neutral; no „Lieliski!” / „Pareizi!”). Keep short (prefer 4–10 letters). UI: type guess + Check; retries then reveal.

games.name: Kas es esmu?
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly ONE person FROM TODAY'S GOSPEL. REQUIRED: clues (2–3 short hints, vague→clearer), answer (short name), explanation. UI shows clue 1 first; each wrong guess reveals the next clue; after all clues, allow reveal answer.

games.name: Sakārto notikumus
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly 3–4 short events FROM TODAY'S GOSPEL only. REQUIRED: items (scrambled for UI), correct_answer as ordered string array, explanation. UI: reorder then Check all together; after 3 wrong tries show Reveal answer.

games.name: Sasaisti pārus
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly 3 pairs from today's Gospel (person↔action, word↔meaning). REQUIRED: pairs [{left, right}] length 3 + short explanation. UI shuffles right column; child connects left then right. Do NOT present already matched.

games.name: Ko viņš darītu?
games.notes: STRICT GOSPEL-ONLY. ONLY use if today's Gospel has a clear action/decision by Jesus or another named figure IN THE TEXT. Question = what would that same figure do next / in this scene (no invented school/home/friend drama). Options 2–3 must be plausible readings of THIS passage. correct_answer = best text-aligned index; explanation cites the Gospel beat (who did/said what). If the day has no clear figure-action, DO NOT pick this type — use multiple_choice/true_false/matching/put_in_order instead. No shaming.

games.name: Atrodi kļūdu
games.notes: GOSPEL-FIRST: exactly 1 item. Show a short retelling of TODAY'S GOSPEL that contains ONE wrong factual detail. Question: „Kur ir kļūda?” Options: 3–4 short candidate details (one is the actual mistake). REQUIRED: question, options, correct_answer (index of the wrong detail), explanation (what the text really says). UI: pick option; after 3 wrong tries reveal answer. Mistake = fact from the text (who/what/where), not a moral judgment.

games.name: Ko viņš teiktu?
games.notes: STRICT GOSPEL-ONLY. ONLY use if today's Gospel has spoken words or a clear speaking figure (Jesus or other IN THE TEXT). Ask what that figure would say that best fits THIS passage (not a modern chat). Options 2–3; correct_answer + warm explanation tied to the verse/scene. If no dialogue/speaker in the text, DO NOT pick this type. No shaming; gentle preference.
